# A1 G3 — remaining reviewed historical source faults

ROOT grants existing manager/I22 one 60-minute block from recorded actual
start, after G4 completes, seals and releases the A1 slot. Any unexpected G4
stop or uncredited M11 reach result requires ROOT disposition first. This
conditional grant creates no overlapping runtime or automatic extension.

Transfer only I23/protected_g3_prep's R01–R52 copies, dedicated targets and
sibling logs. Source is immutable40129. Source-ready semantics are RV29
remaining_08; ROOT manifest hash is
5194a1b926f01b1bc4372ec6771a76a75e2d80fbeb000a3b93855268113837f6.
Prepared packet seal is
cffffde3ae16a32de707c95f34c4030152bdf1c172676633b72d7f99fe94672f.
RV29 last_gaps_09/G3_BASELINE_CHECK qualifies reuse of the existing full-FK
baseline, actual binaries, unchanged tests, empty features and S11 inputs.
Recheck those physical bindings; do not repeat the initial baseline suite.

Execute exactly R01–R52 in order, with the53 mapped fault filters and53
matching untouched returned controls. Source/manifests/corpora/tests remain
unchanged except each copy's exact frozen production fault. Use the reviewed
corrected M37 patch from m37_correction_03, not the preserved invalid old
patch. R50/K4-M31 has the full-core archive and must compile the S11 test
against its actual mutated include inputs; a baseline binary cannot serve
as its mutant. Its required result is the named static site-policy mismatch.
Every other credit must reach its precise mapped numerical/rule assertion.

Before EVERY build, manager independently verifies full source/test/lock
bindings, exact affected postimages, containment, external log paths, target,
guard and exact test binding, then explicitly releases that one copy. I22
cannot self-release or launch Cargo after a mismatch. Apply only the frozen
patch through the existing apply_patch tool. No altered filter, broader suite,
fresh case, new hook, source/test/oracle repair or expected-value change.

Compiler/link failure, zero/multiple selection, setup/unrelated assertion,
generic certificate refusal or surviving required fault supplies no kill.
Preserve it and stop remaining work with its exact gap. Prior invalid attempts
and copies stay preserved. No cleanup, host-tool/environment/permission change
or installation. M5 guard, installed Rust1.97.1/auto-install0, offline/locked,
-j4, incremental0, two test threads, empty features/rustflags and explicit
FK_SEEDED_FAULT=NONE; one A1 Cargo at a time. Check commands at five minutes.
At the total boundary stop unfinished work and report; no further time implied.

Write only A1 R/I22/protected_g3/runtime_01 and R/manager/protected_g3/runtime_01,
transferred scratch copies/targets/sibling logs. Return actual command/source/
build/binary identities, raw semantic results and controls, counts by original
registration and physical experiment, times and exact remaining IDs. No Git/
index operations or Type2 delegation. G2/G4 evidence and V-K remain separate;
this execution grant is not numerical or merge acceptance.

# G3 returned-control working directories

ROOT binds BOTH existing returned-control binaries to the preserved immutable
E1 FK cwd:
<wt>/scratch/i22/mutations_e1/base/projects/chirality-piping/core/solver/frame_kernel.
The library binary remains cd5967f30c1ca9d8957d02126d2639e943435b84f86c5d02c0b21c904af8e00a;
the S11 binary remains ffed9c0f948b771acfd3de71242f38a41dda478839afe7d54de2020f21f9165a.
Their original paths and reviewed build basis remain in the G3 manifest.

ROOT checked the manifest:51 library targets and one S11 integration target.
The FK source/library-test search found no runtime relative-file read on these
selected paths. The two optional external-file reads occur only in the separate
unselected k5_constrained_bodies integration target. S11 uses its23 compiled
include_str sources and the compiled table; its test scans those strings and
does not open relative source files at runtime. A different cwd cannot replace
or alter its compiled source inputs.

Manager rechecks the E1 copy's complete116 original source/test/lock identities,
each bound binary, and RV29's original full-core/S11 include-input provenance.
Do not claim E1 contains the other core crates; its role here is cwd only.
R50's mutant still compiles separately from its full-core copy with its actual
mutated source, and must reach the named S11 site-policy mismatch.

No new baseline, copy, build, overlay, environment relaxation, criterion or
maintained-file change follows. Preserve the preparation's omitted cwd and
record this additive binding in the G3 run. All deadlines, per-build independent
release, exact filters/controls and semantic stop conditions remain unchanged.

# G3 R09 stop — preserve the required far-tail witness

ROOT read the frozen R09 mapping, exact fault patch, original targeted corpus,
test helper and raw failure. The run fails at corpus line2 (tail2^-133), before
the expressly required line6 (tail2^-428). It is a related numerical failure,
but does not close this mapped obligation. No mutant or expected value changes.

After the sealed runtime_01 stop, ROOT grants continuation in a new runtime_02
packet, with the ORIGINAL16:23:26 UTC checkpoint unchanged:

1. Rebind and run R09's originally required untouched same-filter control once,
   from the already selected immutable E1 cwd and cd5967f3 baseline binary.
   No repeat of the R09 mutant or new initial baseline. Record its result as
   control evidence for the preserved uncredited attempt.
2. If that control passes, continue only still-unrun R10–R52 in their original
   order and under every existing per-build manager release and semantic stop.
   R01–R08 stay completed. No completed experiment is repeated.

R09 remains separately open for an additive diagnostic of the SAME frozen
line6, retaining the entire original test/corpus unchanged. Its source-only
preparation and independent review may proceed concurrently, but this grant
does not run it. No generic early failure replaces the required far-tail claim.
V-K remains held until all G3 obligations, including R09, close.

Write only new A1 R/I22/protected_g3/runtime_02 and
R/manager/protected_g3/runtime_02 plus the already assigned copies/targets/logs.
Original evidence and invalid/uncredited statuses stay sealed. Same environment,
guard, one A1 Cargo, exact baselines and no-tool/no-repair boundaries apply.
At16:23:26 stop unfinished work; no extension is implicit. ROOT owns all Git.

# G3 R10 stop — retain both exact corpus witnesses

ROOT read R10's frozen mapping/patch and raw failure. The same original
multi-row targeted test stops at line1 before R10's required line2. This is
related truncation behavior, but does not close its exact mapped witness.
Only R09/R10 use this whole targeted-corpus filter in the G3 manifest; the
other remaining mappings retain their own distinct tests.

After sealed runtime_02, grant new runtime_03 under the unchanged16:23:26 UTC
checkpoint: first rebind/run R10's original untouched same-filter control once.
If it passes, continue only R11–R52 in original order under all existing gates.
No repeat of R01–R10 mutants, R09 control or any initial baseline. Each new
build still needs independent manager release and each mapped assertion/control
must qualify. Another unexpected outcome stops remaining work as before.

R09 and R10 remain separately open. Their two existing required corpus rows
will receive an append-only disposable diagnostic overlay and independent
review; no old test, corpus, expectation, mutation or criterion is relaxed.
No diagnostic runtime is granted here. V-K waits for complete G3 closure.

Write only new A1 R/I22/protected_g3/runtime_03 and matching manager subtree,
plus already assigned source/targets/sibling logs. Keep original environment,
control cwd/binaries, guard, one A1 Cargo and16:23:26 checkpoint. Preserve all
sealed stops. No new tool, repair, scope or automatic time extension. ROOT owns Git.

# G3 — bounded check ordering and remaining-source preparation

ROOT selects the manager's concrete proposal at the quiescent R14 boundary.
End and seal runtime_03 as a partial checkpoint now; preserve its original
16:23:26 end field and all completed results. No further Rust is authorized by
that window. R09/R10 remain separately open. This new assignment is source-only.

Existing I22 receives one 15-minute block from recorded start. Spend at most
the first five minutes reusing the existing full source/file-set/postimage
assertions and existing containment/path checks as a hard prerequisite BEFORE
Cargo in the existing in-memory launch sequence. Keep post-execution checks.
Preserve before/after helper text and hashes and show that nonzero/mismatch
throws before the launch call. Exercise the existing source check read-only
against a known mismatching expected postimage and a matching source state;
no Rust, fake manager release, file tampering or new testing framework.

This is a check-order correction in existing orchestration, not authorization
to build a new guard, driver, tool, process monitor or framework. If it needs
more than five minutes or additional tooling, stop and return; do not expand.

Then prepare only the existing frozen R15–R52 mutations through apply_patch,
using exact pre/post hashes and stopping at the first mismatch. The source
copies/targets/logs and all patches/filters are unchanged; R50 stays full-core
and R52 uses the corrected M37 patch. No test/corpus/expected-value edits,
model additions, permission changes, cleanup, Cargo or control execution.

Manager independently checks every complete copy, test/corpus/lock and affected
postimage, paths/inodes/targets/logs and baseline binaries. Prepare individually
enumerated conditional release records by ID/hash/filter/path/baseline; they
are proposals until ROOT reviews the check ordering and grants fresh runtime.
No wildcard release or child self-release. The future execution must recheck
the exact frozen bytes immediately before each build and remain sequential,
with manual semantic/control inspection and all original stop conditions.

Write only A1 R/I22/protected_g3/batch_prep_04 and matching manager subtree,
the already assigned R15–R52 copies and sibling scratch logs. Preserve old
packets and every earlier source/binary. Return the exact small helper delta,
negative/positive source-check evidence, full per-copy verification, individual
release proposal and seal within15minutes. No Git/index or delegation.
ROOT supplies any later Rust grant; neither this preparation nor the expired
old window grants another run. V-K remains held until full G3 closure.

# A1 — exact tail diagnostics, then the prepared G3 remainder

ROOT read the combined overlay, corrected used-limb derivation and RV29
tail_correction_16 (seal5f023a439f24a30a1cd0b8fa23f0b563b801cd34ac3dcc3a32903022fce65eaa).
Both unchanged upper expectations remain required. The corrected fault
predictions are R09 +8p0 directly and R10 Z+, at the same original numeric
assertion with exactly their bound corpus terms. Earlier loop stops stay
uncredited. This is a correction of predicted faulty behavior, not of truth.

## 1. Tail diagnostics — one15-minute runtime block

Existing manager/I22 receive the three combined copies from I23/r09_r10_tail_10
(seald099ae512ef5c7523ba491e0244480aa7a32a39efe2fc0ca44839c1994d43499),
with correction11 and RV29's source/backcheck. Record actual start/end. First
run both fresh exact baseline filters. Then apply only the unchanged M2/M3
faults in their dedicated copies, verify each exact postimage independently,
compile and run its single new filter, then its untouched same-filter control.
Six tests total:2 baselines,2 exact numeric failures,2 returned passes. Three
builds and required exact list checks are additional. No original-loop rerun.

Manager explicitly releases each build after complete source/overlay/lock/
corpus/containment/target/log/guard checks. Pin binaries and original fingerprint
bytes. Only the corrected exact numeric assertions qualify; earlier/setup/
refusal/compiler/empty-filter or other failures stop the block. No repair or
expectation change. Write A1 R/I22/tail_runtime_01 and matching manager subtree,
plus transferred sources/targets/sibling logs. Return and seal before next block.

## 2. Remaining G3 — one fresh60-minute block, conditional on tail success

After the tail block fully succeeds, seals and releases its slot, manager may
dispatch R15–R52 from their already applied, independently verified source
copies. Record a NEW actual start and end; the old16:23:26 window stays closed.
Any tail stop requires ROOT disposition first. No completed G3 case is repeated.

ROOT read the exact helper delta and read-only mismatch/match evidence. It adds
the existing source/containment assertions before Cargo and retains the old
postchecks. Select only helper hash
b6313acb720917b3bfb549a049aacfe9097bf95f224ec7c001afc794164c1029,
checkerfb78e41a07d518f9e709af48c8fccfcda10fad1d7dde281457d9aad91101e9d5.
Preparation seals1505928f7e577d0af2b56bb69ca6c7b833abd95cba39c34814bf68ab750562ec
and managerd6b316283fb13354e5343bd7476e50a4ada81820b5f200f38e8a7b4ad3759d25
bind the unchanged copies. ROOT compared all38 proposed ID/file/postimage/
filter/scope/path/baseline/patch/compile bindings with the frozen manifest.

Manager must issue EACH enumerated release explicitly, with its exact fields
and new deadline, before any build. The proposal file alone is not a release.
Immediate hard prelaunch full-file/postimage/path/baseline/guard checks must
pass for that exact ID; any drift/nonzero stops before Cargo. No wildcard or
self-release. No patch is reapplied. Execute the original order,39 fault-filter
calls and39 matching returned controls, with manual semantic inspection before
advancing. R50 freshly builds its actual S11 inputs; R52 retains both filters.
R09/R10's completed new diagnostics supply their separate mapped witnesses.

Write A1 R/I22/protected_g3/runtime_04 and matching manager subtree, using the
existing sources/targets/logs. No extra source/checker modification or tool work.
An unexpected failure/survivor/precondition or deadline stops the remaining
sequence. Return exact completed/current/unrun IDs; no automatic extension.

Both blocks use the existing M5 guard, installed1.97.1/auto-install0, offline/
locked/-j4, incremental0, testthreads2, cleared Rust flags/wrappers and explicit
FK_SEEDED_FAULT=NONE. One A1 Cargo; five-minute command checkpoints. All original
semantic, scope, evidence, no-cleanup and no-Git/index/Type2-delegation rules
remain. V-K still waits for complete G3 and independent closure as applicable;
no A1, E_max, W1 or F2a acceptance follows merely from these grants.
